name: ap
label: Accounts Payable
description: Full AP lifecycle — suppliers, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, approvals, and payments

table_notes.ap_supplier: Master supplier record with banking details for payment, tax reporting flags (1099, W-9), and approval status. Bank IBAN/BIC stored here drives payment run generation.
table_notes.ap_purchase_order: Purchase order header. Tracks three-way match totals (received_amount, invoiced_amount, paid_amount) to surface discrepancies without joining child tables.
table_notes.ap_po_line: One line per ordered item. quantity_received and quantity_invoiced are updated by the goods receipt and invoice matching processes respectively.
table_notes.ap_goods_receipt: Goods receipt note (GRN) capturing physical receipt of goods. May reference a PO (two-way match) or stand alone (for non-PO receipts).
table_notes.ap_grn_line: Line-level receipt detail. quantity_accepted + quantity_rejected = quantity_received. Rejected quantities trigger a supplier debit note workflow.
table_notes.ap_invoice: Supplier invoice header. match_status tracks two-way (PO only) or three-way (PO + GRN) matching outcome. payment_run_id is set when the invoice is batched for payment.
table_notes.ap_invoice_line: Supplier invoice line with optional linkage to PO line and GRN line for three-way match verification.
table_notes.ap_invoice_approval: Approval workflow table supporting multi-level, amount-threshold-based approval chains. One row per approver per invoice.
table_notes.ap_payment_run: Payment batch header. Aggregates multiple supplier payments into a single bank file (e.g. SEPA XML, BACS, ACH). total_amount is the sum of all child ap_payment rows.
table_notes.ap_payment: Individual supplier payment within a payment run. uetr (UUID) is the SWIFT gpi Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference for cross-border tracking.

short_description: Full AP lifecycle — suppliers, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, approvals, and payments
long_description: Complete Accounts Payable schema covering the full procure-to-pay cycle. ap_supplier holds vendor master data including banking details for automated payment. ap_purchase_order and ap_po_line manage commitment accounting, with quantity_received/invoiced tracked at line level for discrepancy detection. ap_goods_receipt and ap_grn_line support physical goods receipt with acceptance/rejection tracking. ap_invoice implements two-way (PO) and three-way (PO + GRN) matching via match_status. ap_invoice_approval supports configurable multi-level approval chains with amount thresholds. ap_payment_run aggregates approved invoices into bank payment files (SEPA, ACH, BACS), with ap_payment capturing individual disbursements including SWIFT gpi UETR for cross-border tracking.
when_to_use: Use for any ERP, procurement platform, or fintech that needs to manage supplier relationships, raise and approve purchase orders, match supplier invoices against deliveries, route invoices through approval workflows, and execute payment runs. Pairs naturally with the AR template for full order-to-cash / procure-to-pay coverage, and with the GL template for double-entry posting.
